questions.explanation: For an action in progress at a past time, use was/were + verb-ing.
questions.q: At 8 o'clock last night, we ___ dinner.

questions.explanation: The long background action in the past uses the past continuous.
questions.q: She ___ TV when I called.

questions.explanation: With 'they' the past continuous uses 'were' + verb-ing.
questions.q: They ___ football at 5 pm yesterday.

questions.explanation: The action in progress when another happened uses the past continuous.
questions.q: I ___ when the phone rang.

questions.explanation: Questions about an action in progress use was/were + subject + verb-ing.
questions.q: What ___ at 9 last night?

questions.explanation: Use the past continuous for the longer action interrupted by another.
questions.q: He ___ a shower when the lights went out.

questions.explanation: Two simultaneous past actions both use the past continuous.
questions.q: While I ___, my sister was cooking.

questions.explanation: With 'the children' (they) use 'were' + verb-ing.
questions.q: The children ___ in the garden all afternoon.

questions.explanation: Negative past continuous: was/were + not + verb-ing.
questions.q: She ___ attention in class yesterday.

questions.explanation: An action in progress at a past time uses the past continuous.
questions.q: We ___ for the bus at 7 am.

questions.explanation: With 'they' use 'were', not 'was', plus verb-ing.
questions.q: Which sentence is correct?

questions.explanation: Weather in progress in the past uses the past continuous.
questions.q: It ___ when we left home.

questions.explanation: The longer background action uses the past continuous.
questions.q: He ___ his bike when he fell.

questions.explanation: Past continuous questions use Was/Were + subject + verb-ing.
questions.q: ___ she ___ at midnight?

questions.explanation: With 'they' use 'were making' in the past continuous.
questions.q: They ___ noise, so I couldn't sleep.

questions.explanation: Two actions happening together in the past both use the past continuous.
questions.q: My dad ___ dinner and I was setting the table.

questions.explanation: With 'she' use 'was', not 'were'.
options: She were sleeping when I arrived.
questions.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

questions.explanation: An action in progress in the past uses the past continuous.
questions.q: The baby ___ because she was hungry.

questions.explanation: The action in progress when interrupted uses the past continuous.
questions.q: We ___ TV when the doorbell rang.

questions.explanation: Two simultaneous past actions both use the past continuous.
questions.q: He ___ to music while he was jogging.
